description: Start a payment to a BSV address. Returns where to send and the exact amount; the payer sends it from their own wallet. For SOL, HYPE or BELLS give fromAddress (the payer's address on that chain; refunds go there). Keep `secret`: it cancels the payment before it is paid.

to.description: the BSV address that gets paid

name: janus_create_checkout
title: Start a payment
